subject.title: refactor(zalouser): compile blocks from CommonMark IR

question: Should ZaloUser consume CommonMark block metadata through a bundled-only core-owned facade, or should this metadata become a supported plugin-SDK capability?
rationale: The patch intentionally preserves the existing public `MarkdownIR` shape while making a bundled plugin depend on additional runtime fields; selecting the permanent compatibility boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add a bundled-only parser facade
options.body: Provide a typed, core-owned facade for bundled transports so ZaloUser does not recreate parser-private metadata locally.

options.title: Promote a generic SDK capability
options.body: Add a documented typed metadata accessor only if external plugins should be able to depend on these parser facts.

options.title: Retain the local structural view
options.body: Accept the hidden runtime dependency and explicitly own the future synchronization burden in the plugin.

recommendation.title: Add a bundled-only parser facade
recommendation.body: Provide a typed, core-owned facade for bundled transports so ZaloUser does not recreate parser-private metadata locally.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current metadata design and ZaloUser migration, so they are best placed to explain the intended ownership boundary.
